non assumpsit.definition: The general plea or denial in an action of assumpsit.
non assumpsit.translation: [法] 提出未承诺或否认有契约上的义务的答辩

non compos mentis.definition:
Not of sound mind; not having the regular use of
   reason; hence, also, as a noun, an idiot; a lunatic; one devoid of
   reason, either by nature or from accident.
non compos mentis.translation: a. <拉>[律]精神不正常的, 心神丧失的

non constat.translation: [法] 不明显, 非顺理成章

non est factum.definition:
The plea of the general issue in an action of debt on
   bond.
non est factum.translation: [法] 否认订立契约的答辩

non est inventus.definition:
The return of a sheriff on a writ, when the
   defendant is not found in his county.

non licet.translation: [法] 不准许的, 不合法的

non liquet.definition:
It is not clear; -- a verdict given by a jury when a
   matter is to be deferred to another day of trial.
non liquet.translation: [法] 不明确, 案情不清

non obstante.definition:
Notwithstanding; in opposition to, or in spite of, what
   has been stated, or is to be stated or admitted.
 A clause in old English statutes and letters patent,
   importing a license from the crown to do a thing notwithstanding any
   statute to the contrary. This dispensing power was abolished by the
   Bill of Rights.
non obstante.translation: [拉] (=notwithstanding)虽然, 纵使(有法律的规定)

non obstante verdicto.translation: [法] 但是裁决, 相反的裁决

non possumus.translation: [拉]表示自已无能为力的声明, 拒绝采取行动的表示

non pros.translation: abbr. non prosequitur (Latin=does not prosecute) （拉丁语）原告缺席判决（原告不出庭起诉时，对于原告所下的判决）

non prosequitur.definition:
A judgment entered against the plaintiff in a suit
   where he does not appear to prosecute. See Nolle prosequi.

non sequitur.definition: An inference which does not follow from the premises.
